selection.selector: Native negx front wheel only: X in [-0.225,-0.15], radial distance about (Y=-0.31,Z=-0.12) in [0.065,0.10], Z<-0.155, abs(Y+0.31)<0.06. Select contiguous lower tread/sidewall faces within this angular sector. Exclude hub and all other wheels; remove exactly these face IDs from rigid wheel ownership.
selection.reason: Spatial seeds follow visible component boundaries; use native face adjacency and seam proximity within these bounds, never UV seams alone. Preserve each source face exactly once.

young_modulus.reason: Coarse effective rubber patch stiffness prior; not tire inflation or calibrated rubber.

poisson_ratio.reason: Compressible approximation for a robust coarse patch.

probe_travel.reason: Bounded inward indentation; measure actual displacement rather than assuming this occurs.

soft_regions.reason: Treaded outer surface supports a compliant tire interpretation. Build one coarse covering tetrahedral flex patch, with boundary support pinned to the wheel owner and free interior nodes. Bind preserved native vertices by nonnegative barycentric weights using a covering volume. Rotate all support frames with the actual wheel/steering hierarchy; no duplicate rigid surface. Use a movable contact probe with wheel stopped at neutral for the load/unload phase; measure deformation relative to the moving owner and recovery. Retain labelled failed soft binding/dynamics if the bounded attempt fails.

native_scale.reason: Uniform SI scale prior per native unit; native extent approximately one unit long, no calibrated scale.

native_translation.reason: Derived translation puts native lowest point at demo ground.

interactions.name: spin_test
interactions.action: In the single host trajectory, use bounded velocity or torque commands for at least one full unwrapped turn, then stop; no range or actuator accumulated-angle limits.
interactions.expected: Actual wheel surfaces rotate relative to their parents; report achieved unwrapped angles and visible rotation. Wheel spin is not vehicle driving.

interactions.name: steering_test
interactions.action: At stopped wheel spin, target -pi/6, 0, +pi/6 and return; optionally turn wheels under steering.
interactions.expected: Carriers, hubs and tire support/bindings follow nested transform; no detached visible wheel.

interactions.name: opening_test
interactions.action: Open and return each panel to 0, pi/4 and pi/2, grouping independent door motions within <=16 rendered endpoints. Cheap geometric continuity check uses actual world owner hierarchy at these poses, plus representative wheel quarter-turn poses.
interactions.expected: Native windows, handles, door mirrors and rear spare follow correct owners; hinges stay attached. Report visible disconnects and proxy penetration; no claim of hidden interiors.

interactions.name: soft_test
interactions.action: Within the one host dynamics attempt: settle at neutral, advance contact probe into the bottom tire patch, hold, withdraw, recover.
interactions.expected: Measure nonrigid displacement after removing owner rigid motion and recovery; ensure dedicated render root visibly follows flex states. No fabricated pass if deformation or binding fails.

review_requirements: Audit stable source-face ownership: every original face has exactly one visible owner, including a disjoint front_tire_patch; preserve rest triangles, UVs and PBR. Inspect a compact ownership/rest view to confirm complete rims/tread, door windows/handles/mirrors, hood and gate/spare are assigned to their intended owners while pillars, rails, fenders, sills and corner lamps remain fixed. Confirm GLB world roots reconstruct native rest placement through the supported MJCF offset mapping. Measure spindle addition areas against the two named budgets.

For all four wheel-spin hinges verify MJCF limited=false and no range, no parameters.limits and no accumulated-angle actuator clamp. Within the single host attempt command at least one unwrapped full turn per wheel and report actual attained angles and failures. Inspect representative quarter-turn poses as well as the final pose so a full-turn return cannot mask missing surface motion; confirm wheel hubs/tread and the active patch support follow the spin owner. Do not convert spin into limited motion.

Using a small grouped set of poses, inspect visible connection continuity for each door, hood and rear gate at 0, pi/4 and pi/2, and each front steering assembly at -pi/6, 0 and +pi/6. Record separation at the hinge or hub attachment and identify detached or wrongly moving native regions; windows/handles/mirrors follow doors, the spare follows the gate, and steering carries both spin geometry and tire supports. Check pivot-edge proximity, not just joint values. Retain honest visible-gap failures; only the approved bounded spindle additions are authorized, with no hidden-interior reconstruction requirement.

Build a nondegenerate coarse tetrahedral flex for front_tire_patch with wheel-owned boundary supports and unconstrained deformable nodes, a covering-volume native skin binding with finite nonnegative normalized weights, and no duplicate rigid patch surface. In the one host trajectory perform bounded probe contact, hold, withdrawal and recovery with wheel stopped; arrange probe access and local collision coverage so a rigid wheel proxy or floor does not shield the patch. Record actual contact, flex displacement, owner-relative visible-surface nonrigid displacement and residual recovery. Distinguish owner rotation from deformation and verify patch support follows steering/spin. Report attempted, failed and successful outcomes separately; no rigid-follow substitute may claim an active soft pass.

Use only the host's one bounded dynamics attempt with positive masses/inertias and finite controls. Report per-action achieved motion, endpoint errors, nonfinite/unstable states and neutral/sampled proxy contacts using the frozen contact helper. The 1% diagonal baseline needs no extra locality proof; any extended allowance needs its actual required locality evidence. Broad failures remain failures, and any optional limited-joint backoff retains required receipts. Deliver the native candidate and supported preview controls with separate labels for planned actions, simulated successes, preview-only actions, failed soft response, deferred compliance and missing optional actions; do not label approximate delivery full acceptance.
